examples.en: It was an ambitious new product, but consumers gave it a cool reception.

examples.ko: 부탁을 했는데 생각보다 너무 냉담하게 거절해서 서운했어요.
examples.en: I asked him a favor, and he turned me down so coldly that it hurt.

production.promptEn: cold, indifferent (a reception or response)
production.contextHint: lack of warmth, not a harsh, merciless reality

cloze.en: Public opinion on the new policy was cooler than expected.

nearMiss.hint: 냉혹 is merciless and harsh; the cue wants a cool, indifferent response.

mnemonic: A cool, indifferent reception is 냉담하다.

examples.ko: 현실은 생각보다 훨씬 냉혹했다.
examples.en: Reality was far harsher than I had imagined.

examples.ko: 프로 세계는 냉혹해서 성적이 안 나면 바로 끝이에요.
examples.en: The pro world is merciless. If you don't produce, you're done.

production.promptEn: harsh, merciless (reality, competition, a ruthless person)
production.contextHint: not a cool, indifferent reception

examples.ko: 대놓고 노골적으로 싫은 티를 내더라고요.
examples.en: He made it blatantly obvious he didn't like it.

examples.ko: 두 나라는 서로에 대한 적대감을 노골적으로 드러냈다.
examples.en: The two countries openly displayed their hostility toward each other.

production.promptEn: blatant, undisguised (open about something usually hidden)
production.contextHint: Sino-Korean, with the '-ic' suffix

cloze.en: He made no attempt to hide his displeasure throughout the meeting.

examples.ko: 그는 20년 만에 살인 누명을 벗었다.
examples.en: After twenty years he was finally cleared of the murder he had been falsely accused of.

examples.ko: 제가 안 했는데 도둑 누명을 썼어요. 너무 억울해요.
examples.en: I didn't do it, but I got blamed as the thief. It's so unfair.

production.promptEn: a false accusation (to 'wear' one = be framed; 'take it off' = clear one's name)

cloze.sentence: 억울한 {{}}를 쓴 그는 끝까지 무죄를 주장했다.
cloze.en: Falsely accused, he maintained his innocence to the end.

mnemonic: 녹은 초: a candle melted down to a puddle. That's you after moving day. Like a candle (초) melted (녹다) down.
meanings: (___가 되다) to be completely worn out, dead tired

examples.ko: 이사하느라 하루 종일 짐 날랐더니 완전히 녹초가 됐어요.
examples.en: I hauled boxes all day for the move, and now I'm completely wiped out.

examples.ko: 녹초가 된 대원들은 텐트에 들어가자마자 곯아떨어졌다.
examples.en: The exhausted team members dropped off to sleep the moment they got into their tents.

production.promptEn: completely worn out (to 'become' it)
production.contextHint: native noun; picture a melted-down candle

cloze.en: After a whole week of late nights at work, I was completely wiped out.
